---
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date())`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: false
    self_contained: true
params:
  selection: NULL
  table: NULL
  id_column: "id"
  title: "Selection of strains to sequence"
---

```{r strainselect-report-setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4)
x <- params$selection
tab <- params$table
profile <- identical(x$method, "profile")
added <- c("cluster", "optimal_group", "selected", "status",
           "representative", "group_represented")
metadata <- setdiff(names(x$table), added)
n_status <- table(factor(x$table$status,
                         levels = c("optimal", "supplementary", "selected",
                                    "not selected")))
n_status <- n_status[n_status > 0 & names(n_status) != "not selected"]
```

## Summary

- **Method**: `r if (profile) "profile method (groups of identical strains)" else "clustering method (Gower distance, hierarchical clustering, silhouette)"`
- **Strains**: `r x$n_strains` (`r x$n_profiles` distinct profiles)
- **Metadata used**: `r paste(metadata, collapse = ", ")``r if (!profile) paste0(" (weights: ", paste(x$weights, collapse = ", "), ")") else ""`
- **`r if (profile) "Groups of identical strains" else "Optimal number of clusters (largest average silhouette width)"`**:
  **`r x$k_opt`**
- **Maximum number of strains** (`n_max`):
  `r if (is.null(x$n_max)) "not given" else x$n_max`
- **Selected strains**: **`r length(x$selected)`**
  (`r paste(names(n_status), n_status, sep = ": ", collapse = ", ")`)

```{r strainselect-report-interpretation, results = "asis"}
unit <- if (profile) "groups of identical strains" else "optimal clusters"
if (is.null(x$n_max) || x$n_max == x$k_opt) {
  cat(sprintf("One strain was selected in each of the **%d %s**.\n",
              x$k_opt, unit))
} else if (x$n_max > x$k_opt && x$fill) {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "The maximum number of strains (%d) is larger than the number of %s",
    "(%d). The **%d optimal strains** (one per group) were completed with",
    "**%d supplementary strains**"),
    x$n_max, unit, x$k_opt, x$k_opt, x$n_max - x$k_opt))
  if (profile) {
    cat(", added turn by turn: a second strain in each group that has one,",
        "from the largest group to the smallest, then a third strain, and",
        "so on.")
  } else {
    cat(", taken in the clusters of a finer cut of the tree that did not",
        "contain an optimal strain yet.")
  }
  # factual statement on the actual data instead of a general rule
  key <- do.call(paste, c(lapply(x$table[metadata], as.character), sep = "\r"))
  names(key) <- rownames(x$table)
  supp <- rownames(x$table)[x$table$status == "supplementary"]
  first <- rownames(x$table)[x$table$status %in% c("optimal", "reference")]
  n_dup <- sum(key[supp] %in% key[first])
  cat(sprintf(" **%d of the %d supplementary strains have the same metadata as an already selected strain**",
              n_dup, length(supp)))
  if (n_dup == length(supp)) {
    cat(": they add replicates rather than diversity.\n")
  } else if (n_dup == 0) {
    cat(": they all add new profiles.\n")
  } else {
    cat("; the others add new profiles.\n")
  }
} else if (x$n_max > x$k_opt) {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "The maximum number of strains (%d) is larger than the number of %s",
    "(%d). The selection stops at the optimum (`fill = FALSE`):",
    "**%d strains of the budget are not used**.\n"),
    x$n_max, unit, x$k_opt, x$n_max - x$k_opt))
} else if (profile) {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "The maximum number of strains (%d) is smaller than the number of groups",
    "of identical strains (%d). One strain was selected in each of the %d",
    "largest groups (groups of the same size in random order): the most",
    "frequent profiles are favoured. **%d groups out of %d are not",
    "represented** (see below); they are the smallest groups, often strains",
    "with a unique profile.\n"),
    x$n_max, x$k_opt, x$n_max, length(x$unrepresented_groups), x$k_opt))
} else {
  cat(sprintf(paste(
    "The maximum number of strains (%d) is smaller than the optimal number of",
    "clusters (%d). The tree was cut into %d clusters and the best clustered",
    "strain of each cluster was selected. **%d optimal groups out of %d are",
    "not represented** by any selected strain (see below).\n"),
    x$n_max, x$k_opt, x$n_max, length(x$unrepresented_groups), x$k_opt))
}
```

```{r strainselect-report-heterogeneity, results = "asis"}
if (!profile) {
  # how much the strains differ from the selected strain of their cluster
  with_rep <- which(!is.na(x$table$representative))
  n_diff <- vapply(with_rep, function(i) {
    sum(as.character(unlist(x$table[i, metadata])) !=
          as.character(unlist(x$table[x$table$representative[i], metadata])))
  }, numeric(1))
  n_same <- sum(n_diff == 0)
  cat(sprintf("%d of the %d strains have the same metadata as the selected strain of their cluster",
              n_same, length(n_diff)))
  if (n_same < length(n_diff)) {
    cat(sprintf("; the %d others differ from it by %.1f metadata on average (at most %d out of %d).\n",
                length(n_diff) - n_same, mean(n_diff[n_diff > 0]), max(n_diff),
                length(metadata)))
  } else {
    cat(".\n")
  }
}
```

```{r strainselect-report-plot-title, results = "asis"}
if (profile) {
  cat("## Groups of identical strains\n\n")
  cat("Size of each group of identical strains (grey), sorted by decreasing",
      "size, and number of selected strains (blue).\n")
} else {
  cat("## Choice of the number of strains\n\n")
  cat("Average silhouette width for each number of clusters. The dashed line",
      "marks the optimum, the dotted line the maximum number of strains.\n")
}
```

```{r strainselect-report-plot}
plot(x)
```

## Selected strains

Metadata used for the selection; the complete metadata of all strains are in
the CSV file written with this report.

```{r strainselect-report-selected}
selected <- x$table[x$table$selected, c(metadata, "cluster", "status")]
names(selected)[names(selected) == "cluster"] <- if (profile) "group" else "cluster"
selected <- data.frame(strain = rownames(selected), selected, check.names = FALSE)
selected <- selected[order(selected[[if (profile) "group" else "cluster"]]), ]
knitr::kable(selected, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r strainselect-report-unrepresented-title, results = "asis"}
if (length(x$unrepresented_groups) > 0) {
  if (profile) {
    cat("## Groups not represented\n\n")
    cat("These groups of identical strains do not contain any selected strain.\n")
  } else {
    cat("## Optimal groups not represented\n\n")
    cat("These optimal groups do not contain any selected strain. Their strains",
        "are listed below with the selected strain of their cluster",
        "(`representative`), which is the closest selected strain in the tree.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r strainselect-report-unrepresented}
if (length(x$unrepresented_groups) > 0) {
  columns <- if (profile) c("optimal_group", metadata) else
    c("optimal_group", metadata, "representative")
  missed <- x$table[x$table$optimal_group %in% x$unrepresented_groups, columns]
  if (profile) names(missed)[1] <- "group"
  missed <- data.frame(strain = rownames(missed), missed, check.names = FALSE)
  missed <- missed[order(missed[[2]]), ]
  knitr::kable(missed, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r strainselect-report-clusters-title, results = "asis"}
cat(if (profile) "## Groups\n" else "## Clusters\n")
```

```{r strainselect-report-clusters}
if (profile) {
  knitr::kable(x$groups, row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  sizes <- as.data.frame(table(cluster = x$table$cluster), responseName = "size")
  sizes$representative <- x$table$representative[match(sizes$cluster, x$table$cluster)]
  sizes$status <- x$table[sizes$representative, "status"]
  knitr::kable(sizes, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

## Columns of the CSV file

The CSV file written with this report contains one row per strain and the
following columns.

```{r strainselect-report-csv-columns, results = "asis"}
used <- intersect(metadata, names(tab))
derived <- setdiff(metadata, names(tab))
other <- setdiff(names(tab), c(params$id_column, metadata, added))
cat("- **Strain identifier**:", paste0("`", params$id_column, "`"), "\n")
cat("- **Used for the selection**:",
    paste0("`", c(used, derived), "`", collapse = ", "))
if (length(derived) > 0 && length(other) > 0) {
  cat(" (", paste0("`", derived, "`", collapse = ", "),
      " computed from the date column, not in the CSV file)", sep = "")
}
cat("\n")
if (length(other) > 0) {
  cat("- **Copied from the original table, not used for the selection**:",
      paste0("`", other, "`", collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
if (profile) {
  cat("- **Added by the selection**:\n",
      "    - `cluster` and `optimal_group`: group of identical strains",
      " (1 = largest group);\n", sep = "")
} else {
  cat("- **Added by the selection**:\n",
      "    - `cluster`: cluster of the strain in the final cut of the tree;\n",
      "    - `optimal_group`: cluster of the strain at the optimal number of clusters;\n",
      sep = "")
}
cat("    - `selected`: `TRUE` if the strain is selected;\n",
    "    - `status`: `optimal`, `supplementary`, `selected` or `not selected`;\n",
    "    - `representative`: selected strain of the same ",
    if (profile) "group" else "cluster", ";\n",
    "    - `group_represented`: `TRUE` if the ",
    if (profile) "group" else "optimal group",
    " of the strain contains a selected strain.\n", sep = "")
```

## Method

```{r strainselect-report-method, results = "asis"}
if (profile) {
  cat("The strains with identical values for all the metadata used were",
      "grouped, and the groups were sorted by decreasing size (groups of",
      "the same size in random order). One strain per group gives the",
      "optimal selection. When the maximum number of strains is smaller than",
      "the number of groups, one strain is selected in each of the largest",
      "groups; when it is larger, supplementary strains are added turn by",
      "turn, from the largest group to the smallest. Within a group, the",
      "strains have the same metadata and are chosen at random.\n")
} else {
  cat("The Gower dissimilarity between strains was computed on the metadata,",
      "and an agglomerative hierarchical clustering with complete linkage was",
      "performed. The average silhouette width was computed for every number",
      "of clusters from 2 to", max(x$silhouette$k), "; the optimal number of",
      "clusters is the one with the largest average silhouette width. In",
      "each cluster, the selected strain is the one with the largest",
      "silhouette width (best clustered strain).\n")
}
```

The complete table of strains with the selection is in the CSV file written
with this report (`export_selection()`).
